# getSession

commonJvmAndroid

suspend override fun [getSession](get-session.html)(key: [SessionKey](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/index.html), config: [GetSessionConfig](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-get-session-config/index.html)? = null): [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html)?

Retrieves a specific session, optionally filtering the events included.

#### Return

The [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html) if found, otherwise null.

#### Parameters

 _key_

The composite identifier of the session to retrieve. [SessionKey.id](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/id.html) must not be null.

_config_

Optional configuration to filter the events returned within the session.
